__broaden__.n: n — not; negates the verb ('I have not …') · also in n wn "there is not" · a second word of the same spelling: the preposition "to, for" (n·i "to me")
__broaden__.ir: ir — to do, make (lemma iri) · a second word of the same spelling: the particle ir "when, if" at the head of a clause (ir ꜥq·i "when I entered"), here apparently also bringing in a question ("do you know …?")
__broaden__.pr: pr — comes forth, 'who comes forth' (participle of pri, to go/come out) · a second word of the same spelling: the noun pr "house, temple, domain" (pr wsir "the house of Osiris"); the verb itself is filed under pri
__broaden__.ḥmt: ḥmt — a wife, married woman · also woman in general (noun; plural ḥmwt "women")
__broaden__.m: m — in, from (preposition) · also "with" (instrument), "as" (m bnw "as the Bennu"), "on" (living on), "by"; im before a suffix (im·i, im·f, im·tn)
